ios.desc:
Who out there feels what I feel?

Astruno is a social platform where your thoughts resonate across the world — not through a feed, but through a living 3D globe and a celestial sky. Every thought you share becomes a star. Every star connects to others that carry similar meaning, forming constellations of shared human experience.

You are never the only one who feels this way.

HOW IT WORKS

Write a thought — up to 250 characters. It becomes a glowing light on a 3D globe, placed where you are, and a star in a shared sky, clustered with thoughts that carry similar meaning.

That's it. No hashtags. No tagging. Just honesty.

GLOBE VIEW

A 3D interactive globe shows thoughts as soft lights scattered across the world. Tap one to read it. Lines draw outward, connecting it to similar thoughts in other cities and countries — constellations of resonance across geography.

See what people in Tokyo, Berlin, São Paulo, and everywhere in between are feeling right now.

SKY VIEW

A celestial sky where thoughts appear as stars, grouped by theme and emotion — hope, love, courage, loneliness, wonder, and more.

Tap a star to enter its constellation — the original thought at the center, with replies orbiting around it. Conversations grow spatially, like small universes.

SEARCH BY FEELING

Type a feeling, not a keyword. Something like "I feel like I'm falling behind" or "grateful for the small things." The globe and sky reshuffle to show you people around the world who feel the same way.

You don't have to post to participate. Just search, explore, and discover.

TEXT ONLY

No images. No videos. No reels. Just words. In a world drowning in visual noise, Astruno is a space where thoughts speak for themselves — short, honest, and intentional.

NO NOISE

No likes counter. No follower leaderboards. No algorithmic feed. No endless scroll. Discovery is driven by meaning, not popularity. You find thoughts that resonate — not thoughts that went viral.

PSEUDONYMOUS

Pick a nickname. That is your identity. No real names, no bios, no profile photos required. Say what you actually feel without the weight of being watched.

CONNECT

Follow people whose words move you. Reply to thoughts and watch conversations grow into constellations. Send direct messages. Build connections through shared feeling, not social performance.

WHY ASTRUNO

Because you have felt something and wondered if anyone else in the world feels it too.

They do. And they are everywhere.

Resonate with the world.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Astruno – Your thoughts become stars on a 3D globe and celestial sky

quotes.text:
The idea started with one question: "Who else right now?" -- that impulse when you feel something, do something, or think something, and wonder if anyone else in the world is experiencing the same thing.
How it works: you write a thought (250 chars max). AI generates an embedding and classifies the topic. The thought appears as a light on a 3D globe where you are, and as a star in a sky clustered with similar thoughts. Tap a star to see the thought. Lines connect it to similar ones across the world, forming constellations of shared experience.
Search works the same way -- type a feeling like "can't sleep" or "just got off a long shift" and the globe reshuffles to show people worldwide going through the same thing.

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/astruno/id6758970345
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ai.mokabyte.astruno
